builds.name: Fully charged Absolute Zero ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Fully charged Absolute Zero within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Fully charged Absolute Zero within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R3 full detonation is1275+3AP magic, exceptionally strong AP scaling. High AP/MR penetration/amplification target explosion. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Fully charged Absolute Zero tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Rune reasoning: Nunu — Fully charged Absolute Zero: R3 full detonation is1275+3AP magic, exceptionally strong AP scaling. High AP/MR penetration/amplification target explosion. Bloodline replaces non-scoring haste: 85 HP feeds the equipped Riftmaker HP-to-AP conversion. Keep conditional native modifiers separate from rune proc damage. Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Axiom Arcanist: Eligibility-tested ultimate modifier; classification and true/pet/on-hit/revive exceptions are not inferred from slot alone. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: Exactly 15 earned stacks grant 85 HP, which equipped Riftmaker converts into AP; native output gains only through its actual HP/AP coefficients, not life-steal healing. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Axiom targets eligible native ultimate output. Check single-target versus area classification, and pet/on-hit/transform/true-damage exceptions. Its takedown refund is not extra damage inside one fixed cast. Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Bloodline benchmark: exactly 15 legitimately earned Legend stacks before measurement, granting 85 max HP. Read actual HP/AP after equipped conversions; with fewer stacks credit no completion HP. No extra attacks are added to the scored action budget.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.

kitEvidence.formula:
Nunu and Willump channel a powerful blizzard for up to [3] seconds. Enemies inside are Slowed by [50]%, increasing to [95]% over the duration. Nunu and Willump also gain [65 / 75 / 85 + (0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (1.5) × AP] Shield for the duration before decaying over [3] seconds afterwards.

When the blizzard ends, it detonates, dealing up to [625 / 925 / 1275 + (3) × AP] magic damage based on channel time. Nunu and Willump can Recast to end the blizzard early.

Heartsteel/Warmog and Riftmaker test HP plus HP-to-AP conversion against pure AP; magic penetration affects this champion bite.
